import sys
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/tmp/tests','/opt/emicro-deps','/workspace/project']
import fado_ref
from fado_ref import fado_image, build, _ren, canonical
from ebpf.create_dfa import registry_columns
from syntax import parse
NAMES=['A','B','C','D','E']
reg=[{'name':n,'label':l} for n,l in zip(NAMES,[1,2,3,4,5])]
cols,colmap=registry_columns(reg)
print(cols,colmap)
p='(match(A,A,A,A,A) and startswith(D,C,B,D)) drop; (contains(D) and match(B,A,E,B,B,E)) drop; match(D,D) allow;'
res=parse(p)
names=res.names; cols_of=[colmap[names[i]] for i in range(len(names))]
sigma=set(range(len(cols)))
cache={}
allow=None;drop=None
for node,act in res.rules:
    n2=_ren(node,cols_of)
    d=build(n2,sigma,colmap,cache)
    print('rule',act,'states',len(d.States),'final',d.Final,'complete',d.completeP() if hasattr(d,'completeP') else '?')
    if act==1: allow=d if allow is None else (allow|d)
    else: drop=d if drop is None else (drop|d)
print('allow',allow.States,allow.Final)
print('drop',drop.States,drop.Final)
nd=~drop
print('notdrop',nd.States,nd.Final)
lang=allow & nd
print('lang',lang.States,lang.Final, lang.Initial)
m=lang.minimal()
print('min',m.States,m.Final,m.Initial,{k:dict(v) for k,v in m.delta.items()})
